hero.description: Premium porcelain interiors for Vietnam's most demanding spaces.

origin.label: The Beginning
origin.body: In 2012, in the craft heartland of Bat Trang, Hung Phat was founded with a single obsession — to source and install ceramic surfaces with the same rigor a master sculptor gives to stone. A workshop born of craft grew into Vietnam's most trusted B2B ceramic partner.
origin.imageAlt: Archival photograph of the original Hung Phat workshop in Bat Trang, Hanoi

founding.title: Founded in Bat Trang
founding.description: Hung Phat opens its first ceramic sourcing and installation practice in the craft heartland of Vietnam.
founding.imageAlt: The original Hung Phat workshop in Bat Trang craft village

firstHotel.title: First Hospitality Commission
firstHotel.description: A landmark boutique hotel project proves that precision ceramic installation can protect design intent at full commercial scale.
firstHotel.imageAlt: First major hotel interior project by Perla in Ha Long Bay

hospitalityExpansion.title: Multi-Site Expansion
hospitalityExpansion.description: Expanded into multi-property hospitality programs with standardised quality controls across contractor teams.
hospitalityExpansion.imageAlt: Multi-site hospitality project interior by Perla

residentialGrowth.title: Premium Residential Milestone
residentialGrowth.description: First large-format residential specification — 200+ luxury apartments with full-scope ceramic systems.
residentialGrowth.imageAlt: Luxury residential project interior with Perla ceramic systems

brandsAsPartner.title: Recognised B2B Partner
brandsAsPartner.description: Perla brand launched — formalising the partnership model with architects, developers, and hospitality operators.

present.title: Present Day
present.description: 200+ projects completed. Trusted across hospitality, residential, and mixed-use programs throughout Vietnam.
present.imageAlt: Current Perla projects across Vietnam's premium interior market

kiln.label: Origin
kiln.title: Born in Fire
kiln.body: Each tile begins as raw clay and mineral pigment, formed under 1,200°C. The kiln determines everything — density, tone, surface character.
kiln.imageAlt: Ceramic tiles being fired in a high-temperature industrial kiln

polishing.label: Refinement
polishing.title: Worked to Perfection
polishing.body: After firing, surfaces are calibrated, honed, and inspected by hand. Consistency across 10,000 m² is not automated — it is earned.
polishing.imageAlt: Artisan polishing and inspecting large-format ceramic surfaces

installation.label: Responsibility
installation.title: Installed With Intent
installation.body: We plan cutting waste to minimise environmental footprint. Good craftsmanship is inseparable from care for the spaces we build.
installation.imageAlt: Specialist installer laying large-format ceramic tiles with precision
